model.title: Health DATA Act of 2026
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Robert Onder (R-MO)

summary.text: The bill would require that pension and health plan administrators have access to de-identified information from health insurance claims to help them manage their plans more effectively. It aims to give these fiduciaries better data about health spending patterns without compromising individual privacy.
